videos.title: Winx Club: The Magic Is Back
videos.description: The Princess Ball descends into chaos when Vexius and the Trix crash the party.

videos.title: The Next Step: Cheer
videos.description: Heath thinks Jax is ashamed of him, and Damian questions Layla's motives.

videos.title: Newsround
videos.description: News magazine keeping young viewers up to date with the latest stories and events happening at home and abroad.

videos.title: Blue Peter
videos.description: Abby and Leo go head-to-head in a festive blacksmith challenge.

videos.title: Gardeners' World
videos.description: Winter may be closing in, but Adam Frost has thrown on his warm coat and is sharing some practical jobs and seasonal inspiration to keep gardens thriving through the colder months.

videos.title: Life in a Cottage Garden with Carol Klein
videos.description: The frosts have not yet released their grip on the garden, and the devastation of a hard winter is scattered all around. There is much to do, cutting back, preparing the soil and garlic planting. The first green shoots of the year begin to appear, as drifts of snowdrops carpet the woodland floor and hellebores reveal their ravishing colours. A local woodsman joins Carol to lay a native hedge. Slowly the first signs of spring appear.

videos.title: Naturewatch
videos.description: Chris Packham is joined by Kyle Thomas and Megan McCubbin for a lively, curiosity-fuelled exploration of Britain's wildlife, tackling the fascinating, the unexpected and the downright bizarre.

videos.title: Whisky Galore!
videos.description: Classic Ealing comedy about a scotch-laden ship that runs aground off the coast of the Outer Hebrides during the Second World War. The local islanders have depleted their supply of the amber nectar and are overjoyed at the thought of stocking up again. However, it is Sunday, and the teetotallers object to making free with the unexpected cargo.

videos.title: Marcus Wareing's Tales from a Kitchen Garden
videos.description: Marcus makes plans to expand the smallholding's herb patch. A trip to Gloucestershire to see the UK's largest herb collection shows that even someone as experienced as Marcus can still learn a lot about ingredients.

videos.title: Homes Under the Hammer
videos.description: Martin is in Bath, Somerset, looking around a characterful, Grade II-listed one-bedroom flat. He also visits Stoke-on-Trent to see a two-bed terrace with a very interesting story. And Martel is in Featherstone, West Yorkshire, where a pair of terraced houses split into four flats makes for an interesting auction lot.

videos.title: Kelly's Heroes
videos.description: World War II adventure about an American soldier who captures a German officer and discovers that his prisoner knows the whereabouts of $16 million in Nazi gold. Getting the colonel drunk, he finds out where the bullion is - it's lying behind enemy lines. The soldier quickly gathers a crew of military misfits to help him with his unusual and daring robbery.

videos.title: Final Score
videos.description: Jason Mohammad and guests bring you all the goals, latest drama, analysis, reaction and interviews.

videos.title: Live: UK Championship Snooker
videos.description: Live coverage from day 1 of the 2026 UK Snooker Championship.

videos.title: A Bridge Too Far
videos.description: A re-creation of the fateful World War II battle for Arnhem, where the First Airborne Division parachuted into occupied Holland in 1944 as part of Operation Market Garden, an ambitious Allied plan to capture six Dutch bridges and cut off the Germans. However, certain events conspire to threaten the whole operation.

videos.title: U2 at the BBC
videos.description: Bringing together some of U2's most memorable BBC performances, including performances of 'Fire', 'I Will Follow', 'Two Hearts Beat as One', 'Sunday Bloody Sunday' and 'Where the Streets Have No Name'.

videos.title: U2: Live on the BBC at Tate Modern
videos.description: Global titans U2 perform at the Tate Modern in London for a truly unique live collaboration of music and art.

videos.title: Tracks of My Years
videos.description: Bono, The Edge, Larry Mullen Jr and Adam Clayton, aka U2, join Vernon Kay to choose ten songs from their lives and the 50-year career of the band.

videos.title: U2 Play Belfast
videos.description: World-famous rock band U2 are captured in a 1981 performance at Queen's University, Belfast, performing tracks including 'I Will Follow' and '11 O'Clock Tick Tock'.

videos.title: UK Championship Snooker
videos.description: Highlights from day 1 of the 2026 UK Snooker Championship.

videos.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
videos.description: In the penultimate leg, the teams descend on the checkpoint in the dead of night. Can they make their way through Australia at speed to secure the second most important pole position of the race?

videos.title: Bill's Included
videos.description: When Bill finds out the lodgers have given themselves nicknames but left him out, he embarks on an ill-advised quest to attract one of his own.

videos.title: This Is BBC TWO
videos.description: A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

videos.title: Glorious Gardens from Above
videos.description: The county of Yorkshire is the setting for Christine Walkden's balloon tour of Britain. At Scampston Hall she discovers two superstar garden designers and meets young gardener Nathan, who is just starting out. At York Gate Garden, Christine catches up with an old friend and discovers the Yorkshireman who was the father of aviation.

videos.title: Countryfile
videos.description: Charlotte Smith and Sean Fletcher are in the Ceiriog Valley in North Wales, meeting former clinical vet Claire Whittle, who took on an upland farm two years ago.

videos.title: BBC News
videos.description: A comprehensive compilation of the latest and the most important news stories, updates and developments from the UK and different parts of the world.

videos.title: Landward
videos.description: Dougie visits a crannog on Loch Tay, and Shahbaz is in the Cowal Peninsula, where she meets a couple who are rewilding their dairy farm.

videos.title: Saturday Kitchen Best Bites
videos.description: Matt Tebbutt presents a feast of food from Jamie Oliver, Alison Roman and Owen Morgan. Also, Rick Stein and The Hairy Bikers head out of the studio.

videos.title: White Christmas
videos.description: Two army buddies who have become entertainers travel to a Vermont ski resort for a well-earned rest. However, on arrival they find the resort, run by their old army commander, in need of a helping hand. There's only one answer, to put on a show.

videos.title: Live: UK Championship Snooker
videos.description: Live coverage from day 2 of the 2026 UK Snooker Championship.

videos.title: Celebrity Race Across the World
videos.description: In the penultimate leg, the teams descend on the checkpoint in the dead of night. Can they make their way through Australia at speed to secure the second most important pole position of the race?

videos.title: Why...?
videos.description: From shark attacks to collapsing buildings - why do these events happen?

videos.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
videos.description: Lucy has the keys to the Doge's Palace in Venice, where she has a close shave in a torture chamber and discovers a 24-carat gold staircase, hidden doors and secret messages.

videos.title: Mortimer and Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
videos.description: Paul and Bob visit the Beaulieu River in Hampshire to fish for mullet and take a boat trip on the Solent to try for a smooth hound. Dr Anand visits them in their accommodation.

videos.title: A Course Called Ireland
videos.description: As their adventure nears its end, a stormy round with NFL star Jason Kelce brings refuge in a stone shelter on the 7th. Bill and Tom reach the Giant's Causeway and reflect on a journey that became about far more than golf.

videos.title: Saving Private Ryan
videos.description: Captain John Miller takes his men behind enemy lines to find Private James Ryan, whose three brothers have been killed in combat. Surrounded by the brutal realties of war, while searching for Ryan, each man embarks upon a personal journey and discovers their own strength to triumph over an uncertain future with honour, decency and courage.

videos.title: UK Championship Snooker
videos.description: Highlights from day 2 of the 2026 UK Snooker Championship.

videos.title: Question Time
videos.description: Fiona Bruce presents an hour of debate. On the panel are, from the Scottish government, the economy, tourism and transport secretary Stephen Flynn, Melanie Ward, Russell Findlay, Malcolm Offord, and Holly Bruce from the Scottish Greens.

videos.title: Honey
videos.description: When an old friend returns, Martha faces the danger of exposure, forcing her to confess all to Kurt and make a risky decision to trust him. They must both keep Kamilla onside, even whilst keeping secrets from her and one another. Fuelled by both his complicated entanglements with Martha and Kurt and an effort to outmanoeuvre her, Friedrich makes a drastic move to catch Martha out.

videos.title: This Is BBC TWO
videos.description: A preview of upcoming programmes from BBC Two.

videos.title: Blue Planet III
videos.description: A journey into the last great frontier on earth, the deep. New technology reveals spectacular worlds and species. Once considered empty, we now know life thrives in astonishing abundance.

videos.title: Match of the Day
videos.description: Highlights and key analysis from all the day's games in the Premier League.

videos.title: BBC News
videos.description: A comprehensive compilation of the latest and the most important news stories, updates and developments from the UK and different parts of the world.

videos.title: Politics Live
videos.description: Engaging conversation about the political issues that matter to you.

videos.title: Live: UK Championship Snooker
videos.description: Live coverage from day 3 of the 2026 UK Snooker Championship.

videos.title: Flog It!
videos.description: The team are at Dover Castle in Kent. Antique experts James Lewis and Catherine Southon search for items to take off to auction. James unearths a silver owl inkwell and Catherine discovers an alabaster bust. Paul Martin delves into the history of the English Channel.

videos.title: House of Games
videos.description: Every day this week, celebrity contestants Matt Baker, Charley Marlowe, Rose Matafeo and Jack Rooke take on a series of quiz rounds selected by the host, Michael Sheen. A daily winner is declared following a quickfire round at the end of each show, and the scores are tallied across the week, resulting in an overall champion being crowned on Friday. Will the winning stars opt for the much-coveted House of Games wheelie luggage, or will they be tempted by the House of Games skateboard?

videos.title: Strictly Come Dancing: It Takes Two
videos.description: Ellie Taylor kicks off the week by exclusively chatting to the latest couple to be eliminated from the competition. Also, Friday's all-star panel of Strictly alumni return to break down all the weekend action from the ballroom.

videos.title: Global Eye
videos.description: Bringing forensic journalism from all corners of the world by BBC Eye, the World Service's critically acclaimed investigative unit, and featuring expert global correspondents getting to the heart of the biggest international stories.

videos.title: Mastermind
videos.description: Clive Myrie hosts as four more contenders answer questions on specialist subjects, including the musical Cabaret, King John and the wrestler Bret Hart.

videos.title: Only Connect
videos.description: Victoria Coren Mitchell hosts the quiz where knowledge only gets you so far. It's the third appearance of both teams, and a place in the next round is at stake.

videos.title: University Challenge
videos.description: The round of 16 continues. Teams from Manchester and Warwick return to play for a second time, each hoping to earn themselves a quarter-final spot. Amol Rajan asks the questions.

videos.title: Lucy Worsley's Keys to the Castle
videos.description: Lucy has the keys to Versailles, where hidden doors lead to private spaces that reveal the intimate life of Marie Antoinette: a story of money, sex, power and snowy white goats.

videos.title: Peelers: The PSNI for Real
videos.description: Bert and Harry launch a white-knuckle, high-speed chase along narrow country roads in pursuit of a dangerous driver. In Belfast, Tom's patience is tested by an abusive suspect.

videos.title: Newsnight
videos.description: Featuring extensive coverage of the day's top national and international news stories, along with explanations about the context and potential aftereffects.

videos.title: The Misadventures of Romesh Ranganathan
videos.description: Romesh Ranganathan travels to some of the most unlikely places on earth for a holiday.
